digest.component_or_area: import parser documentation and help generation
propositions: Import documentation describes duplicate creation and future batching but does not reflect ADR 0039 batching carveout, 256-event chunks, and deferred push behavior.
Canonical import parser help must be updated and regenerated into packaged help, overview help, and CLI reference before generated artifacts are consumed.

Help text must document 256-event chunks for independent create, parent, file-impact or verify-command, and comment passes; link and status passes remaining per-event; deferred push after import; and serial source_id skipping with incomplete-ticket and concurrent-duplicate risks.
Generated help artifacts (packaged help, overview help, CLI reference) must be regenerated from canonical source and verified to match via gen_cli_help.py and gen_cli_reference.py checks.
Import runtime behavior and importer modules must remain unchanged; all changes are documentation and help-generation only.
